run_dora_experiment: run a Dora experiment by invoking python -m dora with command line arguments
check_job_and_clear: check for an existing Slurm job and optionally cancel it and remove the XP folder
run_action_with_ddp: run a Dora experiment with distributed data parallel workers across multiple GPUs
run_action_with_git_save: run a Dora experiment that clones the git repo and saves the current state before execution
run_action_single_process: run a Dora experiment as a single process with rank 0 and disabled logging
